manifest_row.title: Appeals court upholds Norway licenses for Arctic drilling

screening.main_topic: A Norwegian appeals court ruling upholding Arctic oil and gas drilling licenses challenged on climate and constitutional grounds.
screening.climate_relevance: The case directly concerns whether Arctic drilling licenses are compatible with the Paris Agreement on climate change, making fossil fuel extraction and climate policy a substantial part of the dispute.
screening.reason: Although the immediate news is a court ruling on drilling licenses, the legal challenge explicitly invokes the Paris Agreement and concerns further oil and gas extraction. This is meaningful coverage of climate policy and fossil fuel development.
